name: Katsumi
source:
The ultimate school idol, she is perfect in every way imaginable. 

Katsumi possesses a sharp tongue and even sharper k̶n̶i̶f̶e̶ wit when speaking to others. All the while doing so she keeps a straight face making her seem quite frightening.

This trait of hers makes interacting with her a challenging task, if not impossible.
translation:
The ultimate school idol, she is perfect in every way imaginable. 

Katsumi possesses a sharp tongue and even sharper k̶n̶i̶f̶e̶ wit when speaking to others. All the while doing so she keeps a straight face making her seem quite frightening.

This trait of hers makes interacting with her a challenging task, if not impossible.
